correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly derives the three camera-parameter critical equations, eliminates the two linear numerator parameters by weighted least squares, obtains the exact Cauchy--Binet rational objective N/D, proves its generic degree 2n-4, applies Riemann--Hurwitz, and separately counts the n-2 generic simple rank-one critical parameters. The published singular-locus and PGL_2-isomorphism results then identify precisely which parameter criticals are excluded from ED degree. Exact rational replay checks all algebraic degree/factor identities for n=4,...,8 without being used as the all-n proof.
